CORVANE ENTERPRISE AI TERMS
SYNTHETIC EVAL SAMPLE: fictional vendor, written for testing. Not a real agreement.

1. Definitions. "Customer Data" means all prompts, documents, and other inputs Customer submits to the Service and all outputs the Service returns to Customer ("Outputs").

2. No Training. Corvane will not use Customer Data to train, fine-tune, evaluate, or otherwise improve any model, and will not permit any third party to do so.

3. Zero Data Retention. Zero Data Retention is available to Customer for all workspaces at no additional charge. When enabled, Corvane does not store Customer Data after returning a response.

4. Retention and Deletion. Where Zero Data Retention is not enabled, Corvane stores Customer Data only as needed to provide the Service and deletes all Customer Data no later than the effective date of termination of this Agreement.

5. Subprocessors. Corvane maintains a current list of subprocessors on its trust portal and will give Customer at least 30 days' prior written notice of any new subprocessor. Customer may object on reasonable data protection grounds; if the parties cannot resolve the objection, Customer may terminate the affected Service and receive a pro-rata refund.

6. Ownership. As between the parties, Customer owns all Outputs, and Corvane assigns to Customer any rights it may have in Outputs.

7. Confidentiality. Customer Data is Customer's Confidential Information and will be protected with no less than reasonable care and used only to provide the Service.

8. Security. Corvane maintains ISO 27001 certification and a SOC 2 Type II report, and will notify Customer of any security breach affecting Customer Data within 72 hours of discovery.

9. Indemnification. Corvane will defend and indemnify Customer against third-party claims alleging that the Service or any Output infringes or misappropriates intellectual property rights.
